moments.alt: Close-up of the cockpit counters: ALTITUDE-FT reads about 81,400 while the MACH drum rolls between 2.99 and 3.00; then the curved blue edge of the Earth under a black sky.

moments.quote: U-2 and later OXCART flights accounted for more than one-half of all UFO reports during the late 1950s and most of the 1960s.
moments.short: U-2 and later OXCART flights accounted for more than one-half of all UFO reports…

moments.quote: To make the new facility in the middle of nowhere sound more attractive to his workers, Kelly Johnson called it the Paradise Ranch, which was soon shortened to the Ranch.
moments.short: …Kelly Johnson called it the Paradise Ranch, which was soon shortened to the Ranch.

moments.quote: The issue arises from the fact that the recent SKYLAB mission inadvertently photographed ▇▇▇ There were specific instructions not to do this. ▇▇▇ was the only location which had such an instruction.
moments.short: …SKYLAB mission inadvertently photographed ▇▇▇ There were specific instructions not to do this.

moments.quote: 1. USSR has it from own sats 2. What really does it reveal? 3. If exposed, don't we just say classified USAF work is done there?
moments.short: 1. USSR has it from own sats 2. What really does it reveal?

moments.alt: The map's inset: a small box labelled 'Area 51' around 'Groom Lake', on the northeast corner of the AEC Nevada Test Site.
The tail of a dark U-2 parked in front of a hangar, painted 'NASA 55741'.

moments.quote: The possibility that the MIG-21 would permanently go out of commission at any time, and that each test flight would be the last, dictated that the following priority be established for the required data:
moments.short: The possibility … that each test flight would be the last…

moments.alt: The black A-12 OXCART, tail number 06932, banking above white clouds, 'U.S. AIR FORCE' on its fuselage.
The rear of the M-21 mothership, tail number 06940, in flight with the slim, pointed D-21 drone mounted on its back.
